thread:
tara: quick FYI — we're starting a phased sunset of the v1 /responses endpoint tomorrow morning. goal: 2-week gated rollout with redirects and smoke tests. please read the checklist and call out blockers. :wave:

jessica: can we confirm which sample apps need changes? i found the react-chat example still using v1.

mike: i'll own the react-chat PR. planning to swap the client call and add a compatibility note. ETA EOD today.

oliver: note on model swaps — the hosted routing will automatically remap model aliases, but embeddings will change dim for legacy models. docs should call out the embed dim migration and provide migration snippet.

tara: yes — embed dim callout is critical. add a small migration guide page and link from the main deprecation notice.

mike: proposing this minimal SDK snippet update (js):
```js
// old v1 style
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-legacy', prompt: 'hi' })
// new v2 style
const resp2 = await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-v2', input: 'hi' })
```
we should include a one-line note about streaming behavior change.

jessica: good. also need to fix two internal doc links that currently point to /v1/paths — i'll run a link check after PRs land.

oliver: smoke test checklist (short):
- hit /responses v2 with sample prompt (latency < 1s)
- confirm model alias fallback works when v2 instance not available
- run embed vectors on sample data and assert dim=1536 (or log a warning)
- run e2e on react-chat build and verify sample convo flows

tara: tagging reviewers: @mike and @oliver for content, @jessica for links and redirects. we'll gate rollout by docs signoff + infra readiness.

mike: PR drafted: github.com/redwood/docs/pull/402 — updates react-chat, adds compat note. needs 1 reviewer.

jessica: i'll queue link redirects after PR merge. question: do we want a temporary banner on the v1 pages pointing to migration guide?

oliver: yes, add banner for 2 weeks. concise text: "Notice: v1 APIs are being sunset; see migration guide." link to new page.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window for redirect rules: 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z — will apply redirects and banners in staggered batches.

tara: timeline recap: today PRs + link check, tomorrow morning deploy redirect/banners, 48h monitor, then widen rollout. if any embed regressions reported, pause rollout and revert redirects.

jessica: i found one more sample: docs/snippets/python_chat.md uses old import. i'll add that to my PR.

mike: thanks — i'll add an inline test in react-chat CI that asserts client.responses.create exists so we don't regress.

oliver: final ask: add a short note in the migration guide about billing/quotas differences when swapping to v2 model families. users keep asking.

tara: agreed. i'll draft that paragraph and push to the PR queue. :thumbsup:

mike: moving to action items in PR description so it's not lost. I'll ping once green.

jessica: link-check results will be posted here after merge. thanks everyone. :rocket:
